full_prompt_en: A square dark surreal painting centers on a gigantic spectral ram skull suspended above a flat horizon. Its broad horns curl outward through smoky teal and olive clouds, while the long pale muzzle points toward two tiny black figures standing far below. One figure on the left wears a brimmed hat and coat; the other stands farther right as a narrow upright silhouette. Small amber-orange glints burn in the skull's eye sockets. The immense apparition fills most of the upper field, yet its contours dissolve into weathered mist and stain, making it seem at once solid and vaporous. Ochre and tarnished gold glow behind its head, with murky turquoise, charcoal, and dirty cream spreading across the surface. The ground is almost empty, a thin dark line and a few scuffed marks anchoring the human scale. Rubbed pigment, scratchy dry strokes, translucent washes, and irregular smears give the image an aged mixed-media skin. The viewer looks across the distant figures toward the looming form. Monumental scale and an uneven pool of warm light create a quiet threatening atmosphere. There is no lettering, border ornament, or crisp digital finish; the image remains painterly, stained, and mysterious.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形暗调超现实绘画以悬在平坦地平线上方的巨大幽灵公羊头骨为中心。宽阔双角向外卷入烟雾般的青绿与橄榄色云层，细长浅色吻部指向下方两个极小的黑色身影。左边的人戴宽檐帽、穿长外套；另一人在右侧较远处呈狭长直立剪影。头骨眼窝里有细小琥珀橙光。庞大幻影占据大部分上方画幅，轮廓却消散在斑驳雾气和色渍中，同时显得坚实又像蒸汽。脑后透出赭黄与旧金光，浑浊蓝绿、炭黑和脏奶油色铺满表面。地面几乎空无一物，仅一条细暗线和几处磨痕标定人的尺度。擦抹颜料、干涩划笔、半透明洗色与不规则涂痕赋予画面陈旧的混合媒材外皮。视线越过远处人物望向压迫而来的巨形。悬殊尺度和不均匀暖光形成安静的威胁感。画中没有字样、边框花饰或锐利数码光洁感，保留绘画、污渍和谜样气息。
style_prompt_en: Distressed mixed-media painting built from translucent stains, smoky color veils, scuffed dry strokes, and irregular pigment edges. Monumental pale forms emerge from murky teal, olive, ochre, and charcoal fields; tiny dark accents establish a striking scale shift. Local amber glow penetrates deep shadow. Broad atmospheric masses dissolve into a sparse low horizon, with a rubbed, aged surface and quiet surreal tension.
style_prompt_zh: 斑驳混合媒材绘画由半透明色渍、烟雾状色幕、磨擦干笔与不规则颜料边组成。庞大浅色形体从浑浊青绿、橄榄、赭黄与炭黑色场浮出；极小深色重音建立悬殊尺度。局部琥珀光穿透深影。宽阔大气色块消融至稀疏低地平线，表面经擦磨而陈旧，带安静的超现实紧张感。
theme_en: Two small figures beneath a giant spectral ram skull
theme_zh: 巨大幽灵公羊头骨下的两个微小身影
name: Ben Templesmith
